metadata.purpose: Parameters and literature anchors for the two Pass 3 extensions of 2022-coccolith-emiliania-calcite-rosette.py: (1) a reduced lumped-plate finite-element nanoindentation contact model on the spherical Voronoi coccosphere tiling (coccolith sliding vs fracture arrest, Jaya et al. 2016 remediation item) and (2) a 2D Laplace / Wulff support-function model of the Golgi coccolith-vesicle rim under anisotropic cytoskeletal line tension that sets the organic baseplate aspect ratio b/a = 0.8478 (e = 0.5303).

primary_sources.use: In situ compression of E. huxleyi coccospheres and isolated coccoliths: interlocking coccoliths slide relative to each other and cracks are arrested at coccolith boundaries (qualitative targets: first failure event of an interlocked sphere is NOT a propagating crack; truncated/non-interlocked coccoliths are shed).
Classical point-load stiffness of a thin spherical shell k = 4 E h^2 / (R sqrt(3 (1 - nu^2))) used as the membrane (shell) path of the plate network.
Organic baseplate / proto-coccolith ring is nucleated inside the Golgi-derived coccolith vesicle; the rim shape (ellipse b/a = 0.8478 on the vendored SEM specimen) templates the V/R ring.
Stage-specific vesicle / baseplate model of E. huxleyi coccolithogenesis; baseplate laid down before calcite nucleation.

notes: The contact model is a reduced-but-honest lumped finite element: each coccolith is a rigid plate with one radial degree of freedom, sutures are lap-joint shear springs with a slide threshold, plates have a bending-stress fracture threshold. It is NOT a continuum 3D FEM with Hertzian contact; that residual is carried as a Pass 4 item.

All constants tagged provenance = model_assumption are order-of-magnitude choices with NO coccolith-specific measurement behind them (no values are quoted from Jaya et al. 2016 because the paper could not be re-read offline during Pass 3). They are exposed as a sweep (sigma_lock x t_head_ratio regime map) rather than tuned to a target.

The vesicle rim tension anisotropy lambda* is INFERRED from the SEM aspect ratio through the closed-form law lambda = (2 - q)/(2q - 1), q = b/a; it is a calibration, not an independent prediction. No direct measurement of coccolith-vesicle rim tension anisotropy exists in the vendored sources.

The 2D rim model assumes the anchored cytoskeleton supplies whatever tangential traction is needed, so only the normal Laplace balance tau(psi) kappa(psi) = p is imposed; the equilibrium support function is then h = tau/p + homogeneous part, solved exactly for tau(psi) = tau_0 (1 + (lambda - 1) sin^2 psi).

provenance.p_turgor_mpa: model_assumption (algal turgor order of magnitude; sets Coulomb hoop normal force)
provenance.mu_friction: model_assumption (calcite-on-calcite dry friction coefficient order of magnitude)
provenance.sigma_lock_mpa: model_assumption (organic cement / T-hammer interlock shear strength, order of magnitude of biomineral organic interlayers; swept 5-400 MPa)
provenance.sigma_f_gpa: model_assumption (sub-micron biogenic calcite fracture strength order of magnitude)
provenance.alpha_plate_bending: classical_formula (Roark simply-supported plate under concentrated load sigma_max ~ alpha F / h^2 with alpha of order 0.5-1)
provenance.phi_residual_abutment: model_assumption (residual shear coupling of abutting, non-overlapping rims)

derived_formulas.k_edge: E h l_ij (phi_ov + phi_residual) / L_spoke, phi_ov = t_head_ratio - 1
derived_formulas.slide_threshold: mu p_turgor R l_ij / 2 + sigma_lock l_ij d_ov, d_ov = w_shaft (t_head_ratio - 1)/2
derived_formulas.capacity_ratio: Pi = sum_j slide_threshold_ij (apex sutures) / (sigma_f h^2 / alpha_plate): Pi < 1 -> sutures slide first, Pi > 1 -> apex plate fractures first
